msg: FINAL landing verdict ADR 0026 (read + write) @ 29d5726 — ACCEPT to land (after the critic). Code matches contracts P1b/P1c: lock local-only, push unlocked, stale by dead pid or age > 2x net under a re-checking reclaim mutex, owner-only unlock, abort-restore of tics, add -A every publish/sync. Here: 13, 182/183, 106/106; P1b 3/3, P1c 3/3, ADR 0026 2/2, no strays. OPEN (follow-up, not a blocker vs main's known hang+drop): P1 failed 1 of 19 runs here (0/16 on rerun incl. 8 under CPU load), detail not captured — make P1 print the missing msgs + unpushed local commits + retry count on failure, and soak it (50x) to classify late-publish vs loss. Also: a commit that fails under contention leaves the tic for the NEXT emit/sync, so a session's last tic can sit local — add a session-end 'tics sync' (Stop hook) as the follow-up.
